'Whenever the box falls, pick it up again' is correctly Response(box_fell, holding_box) with box_fell (the condition event) first and holding_box (the consequent) second. All three clauses are hard, matching the categorical command and the 'whenever' rule with no preference cue; every clause traces to a task sentence, all propositions are declared and grounded, no redundant or added clauses exist, and the machine's final state requires both at_exit and holding_box as the clues confirm.
